snippet.title: Re:BF - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Brand new monsters have emerged and are endangering the continent. With the body of a woman and strength that far surpasses any human’s, the only way to defeat them is to make them reach new heights! It’s going to be a “hard” adventure, and our hero is more than ready to get started.
